text: 中国黄金公告，2026年第三季度营业收入55.4亿元，同比下降62.23%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润5574.99万元，同比增长246.52%；归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润5074.19万元。2026年前三季度营业收入304.39亿元，同比下降33.49%；归属于上市公司股东的净利润3.35亿元，同比增长0.08%；归属于上市公司股东的扣除非经常性损益的净利润3.36亿元，同比增长13.58%。第三季度营业收入同比下降，主要原因为公司回购渠道销量同比下降。
text_en: China Gold announced that in the third quarter of 2026, operating revenue was 5.54 billion yuan, down 62.23% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was 55.7499 million yuan, up 246.52% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company after deducting non-recurring gains and losses was 50.7419 million yuan. In the first three quarters of 2026, operating revenue was 30.439 billion yuan, down 33.49% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company was 335 million yuan, up 0.08% year on year; net profit attributable to shareholders of the listed company after deducting non-recurring gains and losses was 336 million yuan, up 13.58% year on year. The year-on-year decline in third-quarter operating revenue was mainly due to a year-on-year decline in sales volume through the company's repurchase channel.
